pages.text: A cat can starve, and a cat can thirst. Drink at streams and the lake whenever you pass. If you dry out, you will grow weak and die. $(br2)Crouch at the water's edge, look at the water and lap it up.
pages.title: Thirst

pages.text: Leaf-bare is the hardest season. Prey is scarce, snow hides the herbs and the coughs spread. Stock the fresh-kill pile and the herb store in leaf-fall, or the Clan will suffer.
